headline: License-plate giant Flock moves to enlist rideshare and delivery fleets as roaming cameras and to coach police departments on wielding its surveillance tools.

emerging_trends.text: License-plate-reader vendor Flock keeps pushing its private surveillance network into new corners of daily life, now eyeing rideshare and delivery fleets as roaming camera platforms.
emerging_trends.topic_title: Flock Expands Surveillance to Rideshare Dashcams

emerging_trends.text: Companies increasingly treat gig-economy drivers as surveillance infrastructure, a shift that turns everyday Uber and Lyft trips into license-plate collection runs.

emerging_trends.text: Defensive teams lean on AI agents like Backstory to expand a single alert into a map of an entire malware campaign's reach.
emerging_trends.topic_title: Stairwell's Backstory Maps a Malware Blast Radius

topics.title: Stairwell's Backstory Maps a Malware Blast Radius
topics.latest_developments: Stairwell founder and chief technology officer Mike Wiacek detailed Backstory, an AI agent that starts from a single alert and works outward to map how far a malware campaign spread, arguing that each published sample conceals a wider campaign a lone detection never shows.
topics.summary: Backstory is a defensive AI agent from security firm Stairwell that turns one detection into a picture of a malware campaign's full reach. Security teams running it gain visibility into related infrastructure and samples that a single alert leaves hidden.

sources.title: Week in review: Cisco fixes IMC bug, Patch Tuesday forecast, Black Hat USA 2026

topics.title: Flock Expands Surveillance to Rideshare Dashcams
topics.latest_developments: Wired revealed that Flock Safety plans to turn rideshare and delivery vehicles into roaming dashcams and to coach police departments on deploying its cameras, widening past the earlier scheme to enlist roughly 350,000 Uber, Lyft, and delivery drivers as license-plate collectors.
topics.summary: Flock Safety, the license-plate-reader company whose cameras blanket thousands of American communities, keeps enlarging its private surveillance network and its influence over local policing. City and county governments that contract with Flock should audit the scope of these deployments and set limits before expansion locks in.

sources.title: Flock's Plans for Rideshare Dashcams and Coaching Police, Revealed

business_politics.title: Iran Hardens Hormuz Terms, Swaps Security Chief
business_politics.latest_developments: Iran replaced Supreme National Security Council head Mohammad Bagher Zolghadr with Mohsen Rezaei and stiffened its conditions, signaling that any Iran-Oman arrangement would bar vessels tied to "hostile countries."
business_politics.summary: The Strait of Hormuz, the chokepoint for roughly a fifth of the world's seaborne oil, stays closed as Tehran demands a U.S. military pullback from the Gulf and compensation for war damage, contradicting Trump administration signals days earlier that a reopening was imminent and keeping crude and equity markets on edge.

business_politics.title: Netanyahu Rejects Trump's Gaza Disarmament Plan
business_politics.latest_developments: Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu dismissed the next phase of President Trump's plan, refusing to pull Israeli forces from Gaza until Hamas disarms.
business_politics.summary: Trump's framework called for Hamas to disarm and Israel to withdraw in tandem; Netanyahu's refusal, coming despite direct pressure from Washington, stalls the American push to end the Gaza war and leaves Israeli troops in the enclave.

sources.title: Israel Rejects Next Phase of Trump's Gaza Peace Plan
Netanyahu rejects Trump's Gaza disarmament plan

around_town.title: State Attorney General Warns of Imposter Scam Calls
around_town.latest_developments: Pennsylvania Attorney General Dave Sunday warned Friday of a surge in callers posing as government officials to target residents across the state.
around_town.summary: Sunday's office flagged government-imposter scams in which callers impersonate agencies to pressure Pennsylvanians into payments or into surrendering personal information, urging people to hang up and verify through official numbers.

sources.title: Pennsylvania attorney general warns of scam callers pretending to be government officials

around_town.title: Youngwood Residents Press for Flood Fix
around_town.latest_developments: Residents on North Fifth Street in Youngwood cleaned up after Friday's flooding and pressed for action, citing a grant the borough secured six years ago that has yet to solve the problem.
around_town.summary: Repeated flooding on North Fifth Street in Youngwood, Westmoreland County, has damaged homes and businesses for years, and residents say the recurring problem persists despite a grant the borough obtained six years ago.

sources.title: Local residents seek action after repeated floods damage properties, businesses

around_teams.title: Steelers May Carry Four Quarterbacks
around_teams.latest_developments: The Post-Gazette reported that keeping four quarterbacks is a growing possibility as camp performances build the case.
around_teams.summary: Strong showings from Will Howard, Drew Allar, and Mason Rudolph have the Post-Gazette floating a four-quarterback roster in Pittsburgh behind starter Aaron Rodgers, an unusually deep group for a single unit.
